notes.title: Tunguska 2 Development Update, Demo Roadmap
notes.notes:
[p]Dear Ghoul Hunters,[/p][p][/p][p]Hope you are having a great day! I'm happy to announce that the development of Tunguska 2: Whitefall has reached an important milestone: the 10-month-long 3D modeling/texturing/level building for the demo has been completed! Now I have a better idea of what can be included in the demo for Tunguska 2, and a timeline for it to meet the world.[/p][p][/p][p]This is what I have in mind to be included in the demo:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Maps:[/b][/p][p]Iskraprom - previously a metal work factory, now the base for the Vanguard faction. [/p][p]West Petrovsky - A vast stretch of rural region contested by multiple factions.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Quests:[/b][/p][p]Procedurally generated contracts and some side quests. Main storyline will not be included to avoid spoiling.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated AI system that allows many NPCs to be present on the map, who will be roaming around and carrying out emergent objectives[/p][/*][*][p]New survival mechanics during Whitefall state[/p][/*][*][p]Updated crafting and cooking mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]Updated UI[/p][/*][*][p]New types of anomalies[/p][/*][*][p]Maybe - one or two new mutant type[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]In terms of release date, I'm aiming for one of the Steam Next Fests in the first half of 2026. In a few months I'll have a better idea.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, let's take a look at some new screenshots of West Petrovsky from the past month of development![/p][p][/p][p]This is the main road that runs across West Petrovsky. (Took me some effort to figure out how to put paint marking on it :P) A faction took over this intersection and built a stronghold to control the map.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315604/e2d42dd3b8a7fa21ed6ef3359256cae6162fc5f3.png"][/img][/p][p]This is a small radio station that had sunk into the ground due to a past Visitation event. In the demo, it'll be littered with dangerous anomalies and serve as the location for an important side quest.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315604/71623e983a9ee914763e7822ca5197c8940b3811.png"][/img][/p][p]This is a windmill farm that can be used to process plants into more refined ingredients.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315604/4249035558dcab9c80aa23af6d8f537e5be6e388.png"][/img][/p][p]This is the heart of the old Petrovsky villages - the Petrovsky Cathedral. It'll be heavily fortified![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315604/baca51d60f9431697155a5ab0e71f2f30b9aedb0.png"][/img][/p][p]This is a tiny hideout in the woods. There are several locations like this throughout the map, for small NPC expedition groups to set up camp temporarily to rest before moving on.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315604/1b2d60d29f652a3a29d3cd5f869585e9912eda23.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Make sure to check out the Steam page for more screenshots and a new gameplay video![/b] 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3536500/Tunguska_2_Whitefall/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Development Update, Sept 10, 2025
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45561696/cd45fb87a4f52d99b25978d3b96cb8f527315a59.png"][/img][/p][h2]Tunguska 2: Whitefall Development Progress Update[/h2][p][/p][p]Ghoul Hunters and Future Predators![/p][p][/p][p]It's been a month and as promised, I'm excited to show you what I accomplished thus far! I was able to complete two more Points of Interest on the Petrovsky map: a commercial strip with a diner (called "Roadside Cantina"), a grocery store, a couple of water towers, and a warehouse; as well as a smaller village with fancier houses with a nearby pond filled with garbage - a potentially highly radioactive area. [/p][p][/p][p]There is a pasture field between these two locations which will later become a highly contested area due to the presence of inter-dimensional crystals used to power or seed specialized equipment.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315604/2915c7df993d26537e3a389d99221c2224c74344.png"][/img][/p][p]I posted a new set of screenshots, as well as a new "walk-around-the-map" video the Steam page. Come check it out, and wishlist the game :)[/p][p][/p][p]Also, I realized that someone had created a request on GOG for Tunguska 2, so if you are interested, please give your vote so that one day it can be released on GOG :)[/p][p][url="https://www.gog.com/dreamlist/game/tunguska-2-whitefall"]https://www.gog.com/dreamlist/game/tunguska-2-whitefall[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45561696/0016054a5752e34edabac65de57a652c5ee847db.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Development Update - May 2025
notes.notes:
Thank you for following the devlog for Tunguska 2: Whitefall! I will post monthly updates of the development progress as I work my way through this ambitious project.

[h2]Artwork Update[/h2]

This month I mainly worked on a collection of village houses and some old furniture. Each house has two models - one normal look, and one covered in Whitefall. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45561696/6446298b8fa7ee2a6cf4c0f237f6b552eba18cfe.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45561696/ac98dbbb242e3be6d1174878d61b1fe02a4de784.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45561696/6c578fae711b838712e1ce8824d5427f6e875e41.png[/img]

[h2]World Building Update[/h2]

I came up with the design of the first map, named Petrovsky, for which these village houses were made. Instead of the series of small maps from Tunguska 1, the sequel will feature several large maps, each containing many locations for player to explore and complete quests at. The state of these large maps don't stay static, though. They will alternate between normal state and Whitefall state, and each time the player enters it, things might change - distortions, loot, NPCs etc. (also based on the need of the plot). So every time you are there, you must make the best out of it and bring back the most important items as there will be no more hauling loot back-and-forth. 

Also, player can't just enter the large map at will. While at the home base, player must take a shuttle to go to Petrovsky; and when the business is done, player must also take a shuttle back home. Some shuttles are free and only show up at certain times, and some are upon request and cost money. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45561696/caa467881b778399ebaeeb8d47272edb3baab9e4.jpg[/img]

Thank you and see you next month :)
